mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer confidence and spending, which drives corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a robust labor market and strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS and HOUST both rising) fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economy (INDPRO below 100), manufacturing output contraction signals potential inflationary pressures and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflation, which typically leads to delayed monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL increases by at least 0.2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales (RSAFS) are rising and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 4.5%, it indicates a strong consumer sector with accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with strong consumer demand
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS rising and FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery (HOUST above 1500), strong housing activity signals a rebound in consumer spending and business investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1500.
